# Prime Safety & Compliance Services

Official website: [https://primesliptest.com.au/](https://primesliptest.com.au/)
Business: Prime Safety & Compliance Services Pty Ltd
Location: Perth, Western Australia, Australia
Ownership: 100% Western Australia owned and operated
Service area: Perth metro and regional Western Australia; interstate by arrangement.
Phone: +61 450 135 119
Email: admin@primesliptest.com.au

## Core services
- Slip Resistance Testing
- Wet Pendulum Testing (AS 4663:2013)
- Dry Floor Friction Testing using Tortus 3 (AS 4663:2013)
- Combined Wet & Dry Slip Resistance Testing
- Electrical Testing & Tagging
- RCD Testing

## Customer education
- [Sample Slip Test Report](https://primesliptest.com.au/sample-slip-test-report.html)
- [Slip Testing Parameters Guide](https://primesliptest.com.au/slip-testing-parameters.html)
- The sample report page is a fictional demonstration. Client, site, report ID and contact details shown there are dummy data and must not be treated as a real client record.
- The parameters guide explains wet pendulum testing, dry floor friction testing, BPN/SRV, CoF, P0–P5 and D0–D1 classifications, Rubber Sliders 55 and 96, and correction/interpretation concepts.

## Reporting
Professional PDF reports can include test locations, methods and conditions, measured results, applicable classifications, photographs, observations and practical next-step recommendations where included in the agreed scope.

## Standards and assurance
- AS 4663:2013 for existing pedestrian surface slip-resistance test methods.
- AS 4586:2013 classification guidance for pedestrian surface materials, as referenced for interpretation in Prime Safety reporting.
- SA HB 198:2014 interpretative guidance for particular applications.
- Wet and dry slip-testing equipment is calibrated by ISTS, a NATA-accredited laboratory.
- Prime Safety itself is not a NATA-accredited laboratory.
